marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 25 knots diminishing to northeast 15 near
midnight and to light Tuesday morning. Scattered flurries ending this afternoon. Fog patches
forming late this afternoon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in flurries and 1 mile
or less in fog patches. Temperatures minus 8 falling to minus 14 Tuesday afternoon
then rising to minus 9 Tuesday evening. Over open water freezing spray ending after
midnight. <br/>
